sentences.en: We've installed thirty benches along the footpaths around our village.
sentences.zh: 我们在村子周围的步行道上安装了三十个长凳。

sentences.en: The footpath winds its way across open fields.
sentences.zh: 这条人行道蜿蜒穿过开阔的田野。
